def recolor_farthest_duplicate_to_key(grid, key_shape=None):
    """Recolor, to the smallest corner-bar key object's color, the member farthest from the key of the same-shape group with the largest member (shapes matched over rotation/reflection, objects per-color)."""

    objs = [{'c': c, 'cells': comp} for c, comp in color_components(grid, bg)]

    key = min(keys, key=lambda o: len(o['cells']))
    groups = {}
    for o in objs:
        groups.setdefault(shape_key(o['cells']), []).append(o)
    dups = [v for v in groups.values() if len(v) > 1]
    grp = max(dups, key=lambda v: len(v[0]['cells']))
    tgt = max(grp, key=lambda o: min_manhattan(o['cells'], key['cells']))

        out[r][c] = key['c']
    return out
